claim_boundaries: The parent geometry cache is independent sequence-predicted AF3, not OpenDDE.
The official 455 test membership has historical exposure; no result from this campaign is prospective.
Ablations support component attribution only within this frozen AF3-substitution implementation and protocol.
No comparison to an unavailable OpenDDE authority may be claimed as exact predictor substitution.

conditions.description: Full AF3-substitution reference: predicted monomer geometry, symmetric rank-128 pair decoder, learned contact-gated interleaved cross-attention, contact/paratope/epitope supervision, Dice and conditional-proportion epitope auxiliaries.
conditions.name: full_learned_gate

conditions.description: Replace contact-gated cross-attention with content-only cross-attention; all other settings unchanged.
conditions.name: no_contact_gate

conditions.description: Freeze both cross-attention residual paths at zero; retain geometry, pair decoder, losses, and residue readouts.
conditions.name: no_cross_attention

conditions.description: Freeze antibody and antigen geometry residual paths at zero; retain dense sequence attention, learned contact gate, pair decoder, and losses.
conditions.name: no_geometry_branch

conditions.description: Zero and freeze low-rank query/key factors so contacts contain only antibody unary, antigen unary, and bias terms.
conditions.name: unary_pair_decoder

conditions.description: Reduce the symmetric low-rank interaction channel from rank 128 to rank 1 while preserving all other modules.
conditions.name: rank1_pair_decoder

conditions.description: Remove pair-contact marginal evidence from paratope and epitope readouts while retaining the contact map and contact-gated cross-attention.
conditions.name: unary_residue_readout

conditions.description: Train only with pairwise contact supervision; residue outputs remain measurable but receive no paratope, epitope, Dice, or proportion loss.
conditions.name: contact_only

conditions.description: Remove direct pairwise contact supervision while retaining paratope and epitope supervision and the shared pair representation.
conditions.name: residue_only

conditions.description: Use epitope class-balanced BCE without Dice or conditional-proportion auxiliaries.
conditions.name: no_epitope_aux

conditions.description: Use epitope class-balanced BCE plus Dice, with conditional-proportion weight fixed to zero.
conditions.name: dice_only

conditions.description: Use epitope class-balanced BCE plus conditional-proportion loss, with Dice weight fixed to zero.
conditions.name: proportion_only

evidence_class: post-submission matched ablation campaign on the historical official 455 SAbDab2 split; not the exact submitted OpenDDE checkpoint and not fresh blind evidence

reporting.multiplicity: component-family conclusions require directionally consistent seeds and confidence intervals; otherwise report as inconclusive
reporting.primary: three-seed condition deltas with paired seed summaries; test metrics only after the freeze gate

repository.note: Campaign implementation is added after this parent commit and frozen by file hashes below.

training.initialization: random from scratch per condition and seed
training.test_policy: Freeze all condition/seed checkpoints and validation receipts before any campaign test scoring.
